depicted_variant: Rough-scaled fish-tailed water monster swamping a ship by sitting on its side.
aura: Threat or awe from sourced anatomy/action: triton-c01, triton-c03, triton-c07, triton-c02.

visual_requirements.description: Exactly one rough-scaled half-man half-fish water monster, one head with human nose, ears, mouth and two natural eyes; two human arms and five-finger hands; corpulent nonathletic trunk covered fully in irregular dull rough scales, one fish tail replacing both feet, no legs. Bald clean-shaven irregular weathered face and barrel-shaped body are editorial realizations, avoiding any actor or screen-hero likeness.
It sits heavily across one side of a wooden ship, its weight tilting the rail below the sea so water floods over that side into the ship.
Wooden ship at sea at night.

artistic_choices: Choose ship-swamping water-monster variant c02/c03/c07; exclude conch and wave-calming deity variant c06.

Bald clean-shaven weathered irregular face, thick barrel-shaped nonathletic body and dull mud-brown/slate scales are editorial realization of rough-scaled monster, distinct from the rejected screen-hero appearance; no invented anatomy.
No giant size is claimed: close framing and heavy body create dominance; distant sailors are perspective references. Water flooding is physical mass, no magic.
Lantern light, dark palette and painterly staging are editorial.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Triton (fabled creature), the rough-scaled half-man half-fish water monster that swamps a ship by sitting on its side.
ANATOMY: Exactly ONE monster with ONE head, TWO natural human eyes, normal human nose, human ears and human mouth; TWO human arms and TWO hands with five fingers each; ONE thick FISH TAIL ending in a single broad fishtail fin, NO human legs or feet. Entire trunk, arms and hips clothed in an opaque continuous covering of coarse irregular rough fish scales, not an armor suit, no nipples or genital detail. [triton-c01, triton-c03, triton-c07]
DISTINCT ORIGINAL APPEARANCE: BALD round weathered scalp, clean-shaven face with NO beard or moustache, uneven sagging human cheeks, small deep-set eyes beneath heavy wrinkled lids, broad crooked human nose and thin compressed human lips. Short thick neck, ponderous barrel-shaped corpulent body, rounded shoulders and heavy belly, NO chiseled pectorals or six-pack, NO athletic superhero build. Matte mud-brown and slate-grey rough scales with algae staining; NO metallic gold or green scale costume. This is an ugly uncanny fabled water monster, not a handsome man or any recognizable actor or screen character. Head still entirely human-shaped: no horns, head fins, gills, tusks, pointed ears or invented appendages.
MOMENT: Settle its heavy fish-tailed body firmly across ONE SIDE of a wooden ship, gripping the gunwale with BOTH hands as its bulk tips that rail downward. Turn the aged irregular face toward the viewer in a grim confrontational stare. The single heavy tail curls outside the ship with terminal fin visible behind the body. [triton-c02]
POWER: Its documented WEIGHT physically heels the ship and pushes one side below the waves; seawater pours OVER the visibly lowered rail into the deck. A few distant ordinary-size sailors in plain opaque clothing brace on the higher side, uninjured. No magical powers, no conch, no calming waves. [triton-c02]
SCALE & CAMERA: Close low angle from the flooding deck, the monster occupies most of the square and is unmistakably the subject. Normal human-scale upper body plus thick fish tail; threatening heaviness and foreshortening, NO giant size. Entire bald head, both hands, torso, tail and incoming water clearly legible at 200px.
LIGHT & WEATHER: ONE dominant ship lantern rakes across dull scales and wrinkled face, deep walnut-black shadows, salt spray, wet timber, high-contrast cinematic silhouette.
SURFACE: Coarse irregular fish scales, mud-stained matte brown-grey surfaces, aged human facial skin, saltwater, scratched waterlogged wood, tangible painterly brush texture.
SETTING: A wooden ship at sea at night, one side tilting visibly below water while seawater pours over that rail. [triton-c02]
MOOD: threatening and imposing rough-scaled water monster actively endangering the ship, never decorative, handsome, cute, peaceful or heroic.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, pseudotext, lettering, logo, signature, watermark, frame or border; no extra heads, eyes, limbs, fingers or tails; no human legs or feet beneath the fish tail; no film/game/anime/comic costume, actor likeness or celebrity face; NO long wet hair, NO beard, NO bodybuilder anatomy, NO gold-green scale suit, NO crown, weapons or conch; no nudity, visible sexual anatomy, injuries or explicit gore; no generic aura, glowing eyes, neon, energy ribbons or invented magical effects.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

rejected_attempts.reason: Anatomy and the ship-swamping deed match, but the long wet hair, full beard, muscular build and gold-green scale torso read as a live-action Aquaman (actor likeness / film design) — the policy forbids borrowed film designs. Redraw the face and build as the source's rough-scaled sea monster [claims], not a screen hero; keep the tilting ship.
